verdict.rationale: Otter's own marketing says key deal details, notes, and next steps are automatically extracted from every meeting and synced to the CRM. The pricing page lists Salesforce and HubSpot integrations, but with an asterisk that suggests a caveat or add-on. The evidence is thin, marketing-level copy: nothing documents how notes are matched to the right contact or deal records, and Attio is never mentioned. Missing for 10: documented matching of notes to specific contact and deal records, Attio support, detailed integration docs explaining the Salesforce/HubSpot asterisk, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, meeting notes and summaries sync automatically onto the right contact and deal records in my CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio)

citations.quote: Key deal details, notes, and next steps automatically extracted from every meeting and synced to your CRM.
